results.name: Identical validated snapshots issue one request and settle while new object instances keep arriving
Changes during one in-flight request coalesce into one follow-up for the latest revision
Legacy helpers use stable graph semantics rather than object or record order
Scanner changes abort stale requests and cannot overwrite the new selected scanner
Unchanged snapshots do not turn one request failure into an automatic retry loop
Hidden Trends coalesces changes until it is opened
Table position retains millimetres and the explicitly selected movement context

scope: Actual App/Web/trends.js refresh/load/query/normalization functions with controlled asynchronous responses; DOM chart and read-button rendering are stubbed. No browser, PDF, network, hospital access or reader-speed claim. The separate actual-host browser workload covers rendered behavior.
